options.description: List of gron CLI options to enable; each item must specify 'name' (string) and 'enabled' (bool); 'stream', 'insecure', 'values', and 'json_output' are boolean-only flags (name only, no 'enabled' required in value, but 'enabled' key is required in schema item). See man 5 gron for details. Valid names: colorize, sort, stream, insecure, values, json_output. 'colorize' and 'sort' accept both name and enabled fields; others are effectively one-way flags when enabled=true, but 'enabled' is still required per item for consistency with schema structure. Note: 'stream' and 'json_output' cannot be combined with 'values' in typical use (per gron docs), but schema does not enforce runtime validity — that’s left to the consumer. gron(1) does not have a config file, so this template is for *wrappers*, e.g., systemd drop-ins or shell aliases, that want to embed options in a template.
